fixturePreparation.summary: The work lab seed has no Entity or person reference Field, no Matter type with several templates, and no template Field defaults. setup-r1.mjs added DOC-029-named Fields, two Matter types and three templates through the Administrator API; changed no existing setting; and teardown-r1.mjs archived all of them after the runs (the two types moved their DOC-029 walkthrough Matters to the protected Other type). Per-step fixture records (Matters, Contracts, Tasks, Key dates, team rows, archive/close through the API) are labelled "Fixture" in the step text. The own-lab route was tried first: lab.mjs create/up for matters-r1 on ports 23347/23447 failed with "all predefined address pools have been fully subnetted", and the partial lab was destroyed.
stubs: Document upload failure in create-matter: the reviewer browser route aborted the POST to /api/v1/matters/<n>/documents (a network stand-in).
Initial Task note failure in matter-work: the reviewer browser route aborted the POST to /api/v1/comments once (a network stand-in).

harnessNotes: Earlier development runs failed on harness assumptions, not on article or app behavior: required Field labels carry a required marker so exact label matching failed; a Business User reads a Matter through /api/v1/portal/matters/<n>, not /api/v1/matters/<n> (403); the Status strip was read before the page rendered; the History list was counted before it loaded. Those runs were discarded; this file holds the completed runs.

In the full run (stamp 1789572644983), five matter-status-and-archive steps for legal_team_member failed because the Matter header did not render within 30 seconds after navigation ("waiting for getByRole(button, Closed — move matter)"); the later steps inherited that state. An immediate rerun of that article and role (stamp 1789572895317) passed every step and replaced those entries. The cause was not reproduced; the shared lab was under load from parallel agents. It is not counted as an article or product failure.
